_about: Competitive Advantage Period by moat class (stage 2 of the Durand/CAP review). Proposed automatically from 4-year ROIC vs the required return (scripts note: wide = ROIC >= max(20%, r+10pt) every year; narrow = median ROIC >= r+3pt or not measurable; none = below that; short = base growth at or below 2.5%). Edit the class and reason by hand; the model reads only this file.

wide.about: Edge lasts about 20 years; returns on new investment stay high after that.

narrow.about: Edge lasts about 15 years; returns on new investment fade halfway from 20% to the required return.

none.about: Edge lasts about 12 years; after that new investment earns only the required return, so growth adds no value.

short.about: Growth at or below 2.5%: unchanged 10-year model; scenario margins carry any decline.
